notes: r5 = 0x80000001 is a negative int32 but exts.w makes it +1, so the call is taken: the lowering test must use the low word, not the raw register. free(0x8c280000) walks its shortest path: size 0x20 negated in the header, top chunk at mem[0x8c2b1ef8] shrunk by 0x20, next-chunk size 0x7fffffff skips the insert, prev chunk 0x8c27ffd0 has mem+4 = -2 so coalescing is skipped, the bin walk at bin 1 stops on a zero bin entry. r0 still ends as the restored r14, never free's r0; the epilogue also restores the caller's r14 (0xeeeeeeee), so r4's copy does not survive.
